'''Machi Esports''' is a [[:Category:Taiwan|Taiwanese]] multigaming organization.

==History==
===Timeline===

{{tabs dynamic/tab|6}}
* February 18 - '''Machi Esports''' has announced their roster and acquired the spot in [[PCS 2020]] with the players from [[G-Rex]] which has disbanded. {{player|Hong|pos=top}}, {{player|Likai|pos=top}}, {{player|PK|pos=top}}, {{player|Gemini|pos=jg}}, {{player|M1ssion|pos=mid}}, {{player|Bruce|pos=bot}} and {{player|Koala|link=Koala (Taiwanese player)|pos=sup}} joined the team. <ref name="Machi Esports 2020">{{cite web|url=http://fb.com/1297927463726071|title=我們回來了！|author=[[Machi Esports]] |date=2020-02-18|publisher=Facebook|language={{Flag|cn}} Chinese}}</ref>
* February 2nd - {{player|Dee|pos=coach}} and [[FoxYa]] rejoin. <ref name="Dee and FoxYa rejoin">{{cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/MachiPlay/photos/a.222005571318271/1307489876103163|title=不用懷疑，Dreamer、Dee、FoxYa 來啦~目前Dreamer及Dee擔任教練職位、FoxYa擔任戰隊經理，|author='''Machi Esports''' |date=2020-02-16|publishers=Facebook|language={{Flag|cn}}}}</ref>
* June 16th - {{player|JimieN|pos=mid}} is joining as substitute. <ref name="JimieN joins">{{cite web |url=http://fb.com/408470975909516/posts/3006784266078161|title=【HKA《英雄聯盟》戰隊人事異動】
 |author=[[Hong Kong Attitude]] |date=2020-09-16|publishers=Facebook|language={{Flag|cn}}}}</ref>
* September 16th - {{player|Dee|pos=coach}} is loaned to [[PSG Talon]]. <ref name="Dee loaned">{{cite web |url=http://twitter.com/PSG_Talon/status/1306186725215985666|title=Official Club Statement regarding #Worlds2020 roster. |author=[[PSG Talon]] |date=2020-09-16|publishers=Twitter|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>
* September 26th - {{player|Dee|pos=coach}} returns from loan to [[PSG Talon]]. <ref name="Dee ends">{{cite web |url=http://twitter.com/lolesportspcs/status/1309868791631806466|title=Despite the loss today, we would like to thank Dee for helping out @PSG_Talon when they needed a player to tide through the first 2 days of #Worlds2020! |author=[[PCS]] |date=2020-09-26|publishers=Twitter|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>
* November 6th - {{player|Hong|pos=top}}, {{player|PK|pos=top}}, {{player|M1ssion|pos=mid}}, {{player|Bruce|pos=bot}}, [[Mountain]], and [[SoCool]] leave.<ref name="Nov Transfers">{{cite web |url=http://fb.com/1515190688666413|title=【Machi Esports人事異動公告】|author=[[Machi Esports]] |date=2020-11-06|publishers=Twitter|language={{Flag|cn}} Chinese}}</ref>
* December 18th - '''Machi Esports''' announces its team for the 2021 season. {{player|Atlen|pos=bot}} joins. {{player|Likai|pos=top}} and {{player|JimieN|pos=mid}} move to starting roster. {{player|Likai|pos=top}} renames to '''Likai'''. {{player|Gengar|pos=assistant coach}} joins as ''Coach''. {{player|Dreamer|pos=head coach}} becomes ''Head Coach''. {{player|Dee|pos=coach}} and {{player|Leo|pos=coach}} leave. <ref name="2021 season">{{cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/MachiPlay/posts/1550094941842654|title=【Machi Esports 2021 PCS春季賽 陣容名單公布】|date=2020-12-18|publisher=Facebook|author='''Machi Esports'''|language={{Flag|cn}} Chinese}}</ref>

{{tabs dynamic/tab|7}}
* March 30th - {{player|Likai|pos=top}} leaves. {{player|PK|pos=top}} joins. <ref name="Likai leaves and PK joins">{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/MachiPlay/posts/128451455952554|publisher=Facebook|title=【Machi Esports人事異動公告】|author='''Machi Esports'''|date=2021-03-30|language={{Flag|cn}} Chinese}}</ref>
* July 4th - {{player|Likai|pos=top}} and {{Player|Dee|pos=bot}} join the team, {{player|PK|pos=top}} leaves. <ref name="Summer 2021">{{Cite web |date=2021-07-04 |url=https://www.facebook.com/MachiPlay/posts/191625206301845 |title=Dee is back on the field, and this time he's a player. |language={{Flag|china}} Chinese |author=Machi Esports |publisher=Facebook}}</ref>
* November 22nd - {{player|Gemini|pos=jg}}, {{player|Atlen|pos=bot}} and {{player|Koala|link=Koala (Taiwanese player)|pos=sup}} leave the team. <ref name="Gemini leaves">{{cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/permalink.php?id=100002394369794&story_fbid=4610859905670443 |title=If you're interested in me, call me on Twitter or send me a message. |date=2021-11-22 |author=[[Gemini]] |publisher=Facebook |language={{Flag|cn}} Chinese}}</ref><ref name="Atlen leaves">{{cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/permalink.php?id=100000918038908&story_fbid=6741832789190589 |title=Atlen's contract expires. |date=2021-11-22 |author=[[Atlen]] |publisher=Facebook |language={{Flag|cn}} Chinese}}</ref><ref name="Koala leaves">{{cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/a087558189tw/posts/5008336355852769 |title=I have resigned from MCX Esport Team since Nov. 22th and looking for any team/country. |date=2021-11-22 |author=[[Koala (Taiwanese player)|Koala]] |publisher=Facebook |language={{Flag|cn}} Chinese}}</ref>
* November 24th - {{player|JimieN|pos=mid}} leaves to join [[100 Thieves Academy]]. <ref name="JimieN leaves">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/100T_Esports/status/1463613397870661635 |title=Introducing your 2022 LCS Academy roster. |date=2021-11-24 |author=[[100 Thieves]] |publisher=Twitter |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>
* December 9th - {{player|Likai|pos=top}} leaves to join [[Beyond Gaming]]. <ref name="Likai leaves">{{cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/106040958163234/posts/274091791358149/ |title=【Mega Bank Beyond Gaming《英雄聯盟》團隊公告】 |date=2021-12-09 |author=[[Beyond Gaming]] |publisher=Facebook |language={{Flag|cn}} Chinese}}</ref>
* December - '''Machi Esports''' disband, {{player|Dee|pos=bot}} leaves.
{{tabs dynamic/end}}
